target = 5000

    chunks = rng.sample(chunks, target)

    json.dump(train_chunks, f)
with open(os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "val_chunks.json"), "w") as f:
    json.dump(val_chunks, f)

print(f"Train: {len(train_chunks)}, Val: {len(val_chunks)}", flush=True)
print("PUBMED_DONE", flush=True)
PYSCRIPT
